newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - DMCI rated a long-term buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DMCI rated a long-term buy.

text.p: Philippine Asia Equity recommended on Tuesday a long-term buy on construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc due to its high earnings projections for the coming years.

Analysts Gina Roa-Dipaling and Pamela Antay said in their report that DMCI was expected to exceed the one billion peso mark in 1996 from a net income of 494.5 million in 1995 due to higher construction contract revenues and the sale of its eight-hectare property in Rizal, east of Manila.

"For 1997, DMCI expects to surpass market's consensus forecast of 1.3 billion pesos as North Rail construction revenues will kick in and revenues from traditional businesses are expected to grow by 25 percent. In 1998, earnings momentum will be sustained with EPS growth estimated to expand by 25 percent," the analysts said.
"Trading at par with the market, the stock is a long-term buy," they added.
